abstract: From 1949 to 1975, a total of 3,915 chest films were taken for 429 cases of choriocarcinoma and 441 cases of invasive mole. The incidences of pulmonary metastases were 85.1% and 65.0%, respectively. The various forms of pulmonary metastases were studied and correlated with clinical symptoms and pathologic changes. In order to follow up the progression or regression of the various forms, serial chest films were taken at intervals of 10 to 14 days in 27 cases. In eight cases postmortem pulmonary arteriograms were obtained on the autopsied lung specimens for the study of vascular changes of metastatic lesions. Pathologic examinations and pulmonary arteriography were also done on the surgically resected lung specimens. As a result of this study, a relative comprehensive knowledge about the nature and development of the various forms of metastatic shadows has been deduced. It is rational to say that the various forms seen on the chest films represent only the various evolutionary changes of the same lesion.
abstract_ja: 1949年から1975年の間に、絨毛癌429例と侵入奇胎441例の計3,915枚の胸部X線写真を撮影した。肺転移の頻度はそれぞれ85.1%、65.0%であった。肺転移の様々な形態を検討し、臨床症状および病理学的変化と対比した。病勢の進行や退縮を追跡するため、27例では10〜14日間隔で連続してX線写真を撮影した。8例では、転移病変の血管変化を調べるため、剖検時の肺標本で死後肺動脈造影を施行した。外科的に切除された肺標本では病理検査および肺動脈造影も行った。本研究の結果、転移性陰影の性質と進展に関する比較的包括的な知見が得られた。胸部X線写真で認められる様々な形態は、同一病変の様々な進展段階を示しているにすぎないと言うことができる。
